episodes.setting: Locked Indonesian kos room with a high outward-opening window.
episodes.mechanics: A chair scraping ceramic alerts the guard. The survivor lifts it using a towel, resets its blue corner, and escapes through the outward window onto a drum.

episodes.setting: Abandoned forestry cabin on a cliff edge during a pine forest storm.
episodes.mechanics: A fallen pine tree traps the survivor with a long-armed beast in the porch branches. Smashing the jammed back emergency door with a teak beam alerts the beast unless the strike is acoustic-masked to hit simultaneously with a house-shaking thunderclap 3 seconds after a lightning flash.

episodes.setting: Outdoor promenade Deck 6 on a cruise ship in the middle of the ocean during a midnight storm.
episodes.mechanics: The survivor is trapped on the promenade with the cabin door padlocked from outside. Jumping overboard triggers lethal propeller suction. The survivor detects the entity because all hanging gear sways with the ship roll while the entity stands rigid against gravity, then releases the manual lifeboat winch brake at peak roll to crush and pin the entity with a 3-ton lifeboat, locking it with a steel pin until dawn.
